item.title: 520 children waiting for needs assessment across region
item.description: There are over 500 children on a waiting list for an assessment of needs across the Northern Sound region. That's according to the Minister for State at the Department of Children, Emer Higgins. Speaking in the Dáil this week, she outlined that the number of applications considerably increased between 2020 and 2025. item.description: A local councillor says a delegation seeking targeted and specific funding from the Department of Transport for roads adjacent to the N3. Cllr Shane P O'Reilly outlined that the roads are being used as "rat runs", and that there is an urgent need to address the issues. item.title: Local farmer addresses IFA meeting on ongoing protest
item.description: A local farmer addressed an IFA meeting last night in relation to the ongoing Bord Bia protest. A meeting was organised by Connacht IFA, to give an update on what is going on and why the IFA is continuing this protest, as well as to gauge feedback from the grassroutes farmers. Patrick McCormack is one of the five protestors currently occupying Bord Bia HQ in Dublin. item.description: Mc Evoys Cavan Eagles are back on the road again this Saturday in the Womens Super league as they travel to the Leixlip Amenities Centre to take on the FloMAX Liffey Celtics with tip off at 6pm. item.description: A local journalist says SNAs do terrific work and are essential members of many schools. Editor of the AngloCelt, Linda O'Reilly was speaking in response to controversy this week over whether a review of the SNA sector is essential. As it stands, Hildegarde Naughton put the process on hold this week following concerns from parents and school communities. item.title: Special event planned this weekend to remember Cavan
item.description: A special event to mark the 83rd anniversary of Cavan's worst disaster will take place this weekend. A event remembers the 35 children and one adult whose lives were claimed by the St Joseph’s Orphanage fire on February 23rd 1943. Cavan Orphanage Memorial Committee have organised a short remembrance event at the graveside in Cullies graveyard this Sunday at 2 pm. item.title: Inland Fisheries Ireland issue appeal over damage at Drum Lough
item.description: Inland Fisheries Ireland are seeking the public's assistance after a fishing platform used by wheelchair users was partially burned down. The incident occurred on Sunday last at Drum Lough. The damage was highlighted earlier this week by local councillor Richard Truell. The fishing podium was set alight between Sunday night and early Monday morning. The IFI asks anyone with information to call Monaghan Garda station on 047 77200. Advertisement

item.title: Losing weight can be multi-beneficial says local lifestyle coach
item.description: A Co Monaghan lifestyle coach believes losing weight can have so many benefits including a sense of more confidence and an all-round level of feeling healthier. Darren Gallagher has been helping people fit into their old clothes, which for some people they would have thought this would have been impossible.
